results.content:
NMC (Lithium Nickel Manganese Cobalt)

Highest energy density of mainstream chemistries. High tariff exposure via cobalt (DRC quotas) and nickel. Best for applications where energy density justifies premium cost: portable medical, UAV flight packs.

LFP (Lithium Iron Phosphate)

No cobalt, no nickel. Lowest tariff exposure. Excellent cycle life and thermal safety. Growing fast in industrial, stationary, and commercial applications. Flat discharge curve requires sophisticated BMS. [...] No cobalt or nickel in the cathode, eliminating exposure to DRC export quotas and the premium chemistry tariff exposure that affects NMC
 Lower raw material cost per kWh even before tariff considerations
 Thermal runaway threshold above 500 degrees C – superior inherent safety reduces the regulatory burden in medical and defense applications [...] For new program designs launching in 2026 or later, a serious LFP evaluation is warranted. LFP eliminates cobalt and nickel from the cathode – removing exposure to DRC cobalt export quotas and the premium chemistry tariff burden – and provides 3,000 to 10,000 cycle life at lower raw material cost per kWh.
